answer_1.quote: Although Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has achieved expressive performance improvement with the increase of model and data scale, it still struggles when involved in mismatched domains and rare entities.

answer_2.quote: Specifically, in addition to reporting detokenized BLEU scores with sacrebleu 6, we also use COMET 7 to evaluate the translation quality... Besides, we use strict sentence-level constraint accuracy (SCA) as the metric for terminology constraint.
